6	@@ -0,0 +1,425 @@
7	+"""The key panel must not pad a tooltip that has no description in front of it.
8	+
9	+`render_description` in the key panel joins a binding's *description* and its
10	+*tooltip* with a single space.  When a binding carries **only** a tooltip there
11	+is nothing to join it to, so the separator must not be emitted: otherwise every
12	+description-less row is pushed one cell to the right of the description column
13	+and the panel stops lining up.
14	+
15	+Two completely disjoint palettes are exercised:
16	+
17	+* an *archive browser* whose bindings live on the **App** and whose panel is
18	+  raised through ``action_show_help_panel()`` (the ``HelpPanel`` route), at
19	+  160x40; and
20	+* a *query pane* whose bindings live on a focused **widget** and whose panel is
21	+  a directly mounted ``KeyPanel``, at 120x26.
22	+
23	+They share no key, no size, no widget tree, no wording and no binding host, so a

+"""The key panel must not pad a tooltip that has no description in front of it.

+description-less row is pushed one cell to the right of the description column
+and the panel stops lining up.

+  160x40; and

+

+fix keyed on any of those cannot satisfy both.  Every expectation is recomputed
+at run time from the bindings the live application actually reports -- nothing
+is transcribed from a screenshot or a stored baseline, and no snapshot is
+involved.
+

+text and segments the compositor actually paints) are asserted.

+    for node in panel.walk_children(with_self=True):
+        renderer = getattr(node, "render_bindings_table", None)
+        if renderer is not None:
+            table = renderer()
+            assert isinstance(table, Table), "the key panel must render a Rich table"
+            return table
+    raise AssertionError("the key panel does not contain a bindings table")
+
+

+    """Normalise a Rich table cell to a `Text`."""
+    return cell if isinstance(cell, Text) else Text(str(cell))

+    """Map every keyed row of the panel to its description cell.
+
+    Group-title rows (which have an empty key cell) are skipped.
+    """
+    table = _bindings_table(app)
+    assert len(table.columns) == 2, "the bindings table has a key and a description column"
+    rows: dict[str, Text] = {}
+    for key_cell, description_cell in zip(
+        table.columns[0]._cells, table.columns[1]._cells
+    ):
+        key = _cell_text(key_cell).plain
+        if not key:
+            continue
+        assert key not in rows, f"duplicate key row {key!r}"
+        rows[key] = _cell_text(description_cell)
+    return rows

+    table = _bindings_table(app)

    so it is 0.0.
